annotations.title: Verify a receipt against the record

description: Recompute and check one receipt end to end: the row's receipt hash recomputed from its own sealed document, the link to the row before it, the day root its day folds into, and that root's anchor state (confirmed with a block height, or pending). Every check is named in the verdict, and a check that could not run says so rather than passing. Rate: never metered (verification is on the price book's never_metered list).

receipt_hash.description: The 64-character hex receipt hash, as printed on a receipt or returned by the other record tools.
